question: FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup 2022 final was held in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Navi Mumbai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The final match of the **FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup 2022** was held in **Navi Mumbai**.
 
• The tournament is an international football competition organized by **FIFA** for female players under the age of 17.
 
• Navi Mumbai is one of the prominent cities in the state of Maharashtra, India, and has hosted several international sporting events.
 
• The **D.Y. Patil Stadium** in Navi Mumbai was the venue for the final match, known for its state-of-the-art facilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup** is held every two years, bringing together the best young female football talent from around the world.
 
• The 2022 edition was the **7th edition** of the tournament.
 
• It serves as a platform for young female athletes to showcase their skills on an international stage and gain valuable experience.
 
• India hosted the tournament for the first time in 2022, marking a significant moment in the country's football history.
